title: Mujhe maulai banana
body:
Mujhe maulai banana
Aise parwan chadhana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko dena ye khazana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Maa mujhe khoob padhana, aur namazi bhi banana..(2)
aur tabarra bhi sikhana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kar du duniya ko mai qaael, aise maula ke fazael..(2)
mujhe lori me sunana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maa mujhe jab bhi sulana, marsiye nauhe sunana..(2)
Ya Ali kehke jagana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aaye jab aath moharram, to mere waaste paiham..(2)
ek alam ghar me sajana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mana hai umr abhi kam, maa mujhe karna hai matam..(2)
mujhe zanjeer dilana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mujhko jo khana khilana, thanda pani jo pilana..(2)
karbala yaad dilana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zikr e sarwar ho mera kaam, gunje duniya me mera naam..(2)
nauhakhwan mujhko banana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jo wila se mujhe roke, jo aza pe mujhe toke..(2)
aise logo se bachana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aaye jab aisa zamana, jab mere sehra sajana..(2)
nauha akbar ka padhana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ye nahi maa ko nasihat, ye hai bus joshe aqeedat..(2)
iska maqsad hai batana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Hai khuda se yahi hajat, rakh meri maa ko salamat..(2)
jisne is baat ko maana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Manqabat zille raza ki, ye jo farha ne sunayi..(2)
ye hai bachpan ka tarana
<<MINI>>
mujhe maulai banana, aye meri maa..(3)
author: Farhan Ali
